Attention Fishermen! The Fishing Bonanza Is Here!!


The chance of fish or objects getting caught will be "Doubled" during the period below!

You can expect to catch more fish or objects than usual, so make sure to grab this opportunity to play the "Fishing" mini game!

Fishing Bonanza Period

From: October 26th, 2026 at 6:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until: October 29th, 2026 before the maintenance

★: Intro to "Fishing" Mini Game

Intro to "Fishing" Mini Game



Once you have created the furniture "Fishing Workbench", you will be able to play the mini game.
You will see the option "Fishing Gear" in the Character menu and "Start Fishing" will be added to shortcuts.

You can catch various kinds of fish and process them to earn "Ingredient Points".
Furthermore, there are also exclusive items you can only get through fishing.

Please see "this news" for details about the "Fishing" mini game!

Notes


* The types of fish or objects that could get caught on your hook remain the same.
* You can get the event bonus effect by starting a new "Fishing" mini game during the event.
* Please note that the available period may be shortened or changed.
* Limited-time events or promotions may be held again in the future on different conditions after they have ended.
* Please note that in-game text and descriptions are subject to change at a later date.
